title: Fifthbell robots.txt input
description: The rules of one site's robots.txt as the CMS sends them (fifthbell/cronkite#156). At least one rule is required, and every rule needs at least one Allow or Disallow line: a document with none, or a group with neither, is refused, because an empty group allows everything and a missing rule set must never render as allow-all. Every value is one line of plain text with no control characters, so no value can add a directive. Keys Brokaw does not know are ignored.

layout.description: Optional: the publish request names the renderable. When present it must be this renderable's name. A producer whose gateway validates any document that has a layout as a canonical document leaves it out.

line.description: One line of text: not empty, no line break and no other control character.

sitemapUrl.description: An absolute https URL with no whitespace or control character.
